title: Cliff Elevation-Delta + Full Authored Diagonal Alignment
behaviorTarget: Preserve true modular Level-2 cliff height while sizing each visible south face from its exact structural edge delta and restoring the complete authored diagonal shoulder/body/foot projection so straight and angled feet align.
terrainCorrections: South-face height is derived from the exact SOUTH edge delta instead of the host cell maximum face_segments value when edge delta data is present.
Level 1->0 and Level 2->1 edges use one authored module; Level 2->0 edges use two authored modules.
Connected rounded diagonals retain the complete authored lip -> shoulder -> repeatable body -> foot stack; the compact shoulder-skipping projection is retired.
Level-2 straight and diagonal feet both land on host+4; Level-1 feet both land on host+3.
South-face collision uses the same exact edge-specific module count and complete base projection depth as rendering.
runtimeEvidence: W9 fresh-world screenshots showed a true Level-2 cliff where straight horizontal faces and angled bottoms were vertically out of phase; the user explicitly confirmed the cliff should remain Level-2 modular height.
localCompileGate: Run HavenwildTools option 2 (Build development fast) after applying this cumulative patch.
